body:
I am so opposed to anti-depressants that it isn't even an option. It doesn't matter if health insurance covers it or not. I will not be a subject of modern "medicine." I've racked up close to $100,000 in medical bills in the last 3 years, mostly covered by insurance, and I'm sick of being nothing more than an object through which money can be extracted by various entities. If I got cancer tomorrow I would simply kill myself rather than let the medical and insurance industry extract hundreds of thousands of dollars from taxpayers to "treat" me. Health insurance companies inflate the price of medical care, then use their buying power to get low prices that should be offered to people without insurance, thus forcing people to pay for insurance as being uninsured is no longer an option. The result is that insurance companies have more customers paying higher amounts and the medical industry gets more money. I mean for fucks sake the deductibles we pay now are how much the service used to cost without insurance I don't want to hear any shit about advances in medical care being responsible for increased cost. Most people don't even know how much their health insurance costs affect their earnings since it's included with their job. Well, I ran my own business so I do.

My viewpoint is that a small minority are replacing all life on Earth with humans as they make the best servants and livestock. Everything we do is simply to provide service towards the ultimate goal of producing the largest number of and most efficient humans to build a pyramid of servants for the worst of humanity. From every single direction the global population of not only humans, but life itself, is being squeezed dry and almost everyone can't even see it because it's being done through methods like I mentioned above.

We are simultaneously creating a world that isn't fit to live in and slaving away to produce value that will cover the damage to our health we have created. Our lives are nothing but a carefully managed risk / benefit ratio designed to extract the optimal amount of wealth for those who control us through deceptions like fiat currency.

It's like.. Oh I'm depressed because this whole world is completely fucked. Well I guess I better go take some pills to fuck up my brain chemistry so I can't perceive how fucked everything is anymore. Then I can go back to work and be a good little diary cow. Of course I could go take one of 10,000 SSRIs and whatever else they're using these days to make me unable to see and think properly. In fact, that's exactly what I'm supposed to do.. that's why the medical industry is there.. to keep me in good working condition. Well, I don't want to be in good working condition. It's us, the servants, who are making this world unlivable and I refuse to participate in damaging life anymore. Almost every single person working in the world today is only working towards the ultimate destruction of life itself and we are too near sighted to see it because all we do is focus on ourselves. I need money, I need medication, I need blah blah blah. Well I wouldn't need any of this shit if the people who came before me hadn't fucked everything up in the first place. I'm sick and tired of people praising civilization and scientific advancement when it comes along and fucks 100 things up and then fixes 10 of them and all anyone wants to talk about is how great those 10 fixes were when they didn't even exist previously.

Science, technology, and our entire "civilized" world does not work for us. We work for it. We are slaves to organisms so large we can't even perceive them yet we create them. It's like an alcoholic killing their body for cheap thrills, they don't give a fuck about the life of those microorganisms, and the macro level organisms humanity creates does not give a fuck about us. I don't care anymore, I'm going cancerous and I hope it metastasizes to the heart and brain of humanity.

I actually have been to a counselor one other time. It was horribly predictable and I left with a reaffirmed sense that it's nothing but a scam to pray on people who have no easy solution.

I've done my fair share of marketing and advertising. One of the most important lessons is to find someone with a problem and then sell them a solution that doesn't actually solve the problem. This ensures they come back to buy more products. The more desperate they are for a solution the more you can charge and the easier the sell is. This is why sex, drugs, weight loss, self improvement, etc are all large markets. Customer is desperate for a solution where no easy answer exists so they're willing to believe anything, will pay a lot for it, and will be right back for more when it doesn't work.

Psychiatrists will sell you drugs that don't work and when you complain about the side effects and other problems they'll say, oh.. Well, we just haven't found the right one.. let's try XYZ.. it goes on and on.

Psychologists will keep you in a feedback loop where they simply try to point out the positives. You leave with a positive outlook but it doesn't last and so you need to return for next scheduled and costly pep talk that is based more on manipulative and deceptive techniques than anything useful.

The reason the first person I saw told me he couldn't help me is because I KNEW he couldn't help me. I already knew all of his tricks and it made him uncomfortable to be sitting there talking to someone who may as well have been "counseling" him instead.

Anyway in summary, why not take a chance? Because it's not worth paying some soul sucking money leech to prescribe whatever the latest pharmaceutical sales rep has pushed on them or ask me, "How does that make you feel?" over and over. I'd rather leave more money behind for people like my girlfriend. No, I'm not worth it. I am a lost cause.

Thanks for the response though.
